summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the redemption of its class C preferred shares (PNC), a capital return to shareholders. The redemption amount is R$53.71 per share, based on the August 5, 2026 closing price of common shares. Record date is end of August 7, 2026, with payment in Brazilian currency on August 24, 2026; ADR holders receive payment within seven business days thereafter. The filing details tax treatment, including withholding for non-resident investors at rates up to 25%. No advisor or board recommendation mentioned. This is a mandatory redemption, not a tender offer. Watch for investor tax documentation and payment timing.
